Both responses reach the correct answer: 671/1296 ≈ 51.8%. Both also stay under the 120-word limit.

Response A explains each step of the complement method more clearly. It states the single-roll probability of no six (5/6) before raising it to the fourth power. It also adds an accurate historical note: this is the Chevalier de Méré's classic problem.

Response B is correct but more terse. It skips the explanation of why the complement works and where 5/6 comes from.
